items.title: HKICL alerts public of fraudulent websites
items.summary: HKICL warned the public about fraudulent websites impersonating its services; this is an operational fraud alert, not a rule change.
evidence: Hong Kong Interbank Clearing Limited (HKICL) has recently noted two fraudulent websites purported to be from HKICL: Type 1: fpshkpay.life
HKICL advises that these fraudulent websites have no affiliation with HKICL, or any business of HKICL.
The genuine official website addresses of HKICL are https://www.hkicl.com.hk and https://fps.hkicl.com.hk

items.title: Exchange Publishes Consultation Paper on Phase II of Listing Framework Competitiveness Review
items.summary: HKEX is consulting on changes to post-listing transaction, connected-transaction and spin-off requirements.
evidence: Exchange Publishes Consultation Paper on Phase II of Listing Framework Competitiveness Review
The Exchange publishes proposals to enhance the competitiveness of its listing framework

The proposals form the second phase of the Exchange's listing framework competitiveness review and focus on the post-listing requirements governing notifiable transactions, connected transactions and spin-off transactions.

evidence: The People’s Bank of China (the PBOC) will issue Renminbi Bills through the Central Moneymarkets Unit of the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (the HKMA).
Please find attached the tender notice and the tender information memorandum of the Renminbi Bills to be issued by the PBOC.

items.title: Statistics of Payment Cards Issued in Hong Kong for Second Quarter 2026
items.summary: HKMA releases Q2 2026 payment card statistics with credit/debit card transaction data
evidence: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) published today statistics of payment cards issued in Hong Kong for the second quarter of 2026.

The payment card statistics (see Annex ) include quarterly data on credit and debit cards issued in Hong Kong under the credit and/or debit card schemes of the eight payment card scheme operators ( Note 1 ).
According to the quarterly statistics, the total number of credit cards in circulation ( Note 2 ) was 31.03 million by the end of Q2/2026.
